parameters.query:
SELECT id, display_name, target_roles, skills, must_have, avoid_keywords,
       experience_years::float8 AS experience_years, preferred_locations, work_modes
FROM candidate_profile
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.title,
    j.company,
    j.location,
    j.work_mode,
    j.description
FROM jobs j
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM job_matches m
    WHERE m.job_id = j.id
      AND m.profile_id = $1
      AND m.scoring_version = 'v1'
)
ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC NULLS LAST, j.id DESC
LIMIT 10;

INSERT INTO job_matches
  (job_id, profile_id, rules_score, ai_score, final_score,
   matched_skills, missing_skills, reasoning, red_flags,
   needs_review, model_name, scoring_version)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3::numeric, $4::numeric, $5::numeric,
   ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($6::jsonb)),
   ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($7::jsonb)),
   $8,
   ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($9::jsonb)),
   $10::boolean, $11, $12)
ON CONFLICT (job_id, profile_id, scoring_version) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
